decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch with sound builds on the firm's established arch and decorative lighting knowledge, enabling effective assimilation of feedback and improvement.
The one-tier Christmas pyramid leverages existing pyramid construction and carving expertise, so the firm can interpret results and refine the product.
The Christmas motif platform is tied to the distant electronic music box line and lacks related in-house knowledge, making learning and improvement unlikely.
The Dresden-themed Christmas pyramid builds directly on the firm's established pyramid and painting skills, supporting absorption of market feedback and incremental refinement.
